title: How we collect and show reviews
seo_title: How We Collect and Show Reviews | PawLunova
seo_description: Only buyers can review, every star rating is published and nothing is offered for a good review. How PawLunova collects reviews and handles fake ones.
body_html:
Reviews only help if you can trust them. This page sets out how PawLunova asks for reviews, what we publish, and what we do when a review doesn't look right.

Who can leave a review

  • Only people who have bought from us. We ask by email after a bed has been delivered, and every review is tied to a real order.
  • Beds given free are labelled. If we give a bed to an owner to try, for example someone with an older or larger dog, their review is marked "Received free for review".
  • No reviews from us or people close to us. We don't write reviews ourselves, and we don't ask friends, family or anyone who works with us to review a bed they haven't bought.
  • Older reviews are only brought across if they are real. We only import a review from an earlier version of our shop if we can match it to a real order, and it keeps its original date and product.

What we publish

  • Every genuine review, whatever the star rating. One star or five, it goes up.
  • Your words, unedited. We don't change what you write. We may hold back a review that includes someone's personal details, offensive language or something that isn't about the product, and if we do, we'll tell you why.
  • No stars until there are real ones. A bed only shows a star rating and a review count once it has at least five genuine reviews. Until then it shows none, rather than a number we can't back up.
  • Numbers come from the review app. Any average or count on the site comes straight from our review app. Nobody types one in.

Thank-yous and incentives

We never offer anything in return for a good review, and we never ask anyone to change or take down a bad one. If we ever thank people for reviewing, everyone gets the same thank-you whatever they say, and each review shows that it was thanked.

Fake or edited reviews

  • If a review can't be matched to an order, or looks copied, automated or written to promote or attack a product, we check it before it is published, and we keep a record of anything we remove and why.
  • Reviewers can add an update later, for example after a few months with the bed. Updates are shown with their date, next to the original review.
  • If you think a review on our site isn't genuine, email abbas@pawlunova.co.uk and we'll look into it.

Replies

We read every review and reply where we can help, critical ones first. If something isn't right with your bed, you don't need to wait for a review: message us and we'll sort it.

Abbas, PawLunova
PawLunova is a trading name of Yutani Ltd, Bury.

Publish it, and link it from the reviews section, only once a review app is installed and set up to match: verified-buyer requests after delivery, every rating published, no rating shown below five genuine reviews, review updates with dates, 'Received free for review' labels on seeded beds (audit S11).
'We ask by email after a bed has been delivered': true only once the day-14 and day-60 review request emails (content/emails/) are switched on in the review app.
'If we do, we'll tell you why' and 'we keep a record of anything we remove and why' are commitments: keep them, or change the wording before publishing.

No thank-you scheme exists yet. The page says 'If we ever thank people'. If the owner chooses the audit's option (a £5 donation to a named dog rescue per review, or a spare-cover code), name it here and on every review it applies to, and give it for every review whatever the rating.
No reply time is promised (audit P0-5: only promise a reply time you can keep).
